newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish advertisers see more advertising in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Finnish advertisers see more advertising in 1997.

text.p: Thirty-seven percent of Finnish advertisers expect to increase advertising next year compared to only four percent expecting a reduction, the advertisers association said in its yearly advertising barometer.
The average increase among those budgeting for a rise was 11 percent, it said in the survey, released on Thursday.
Those expecting to increase newspaper advertising outnumbered those expecting to reduce it by 14 percentage points and in domestic TV advertising, the difference was 37 percentage points.
Local radio advertising was third, with a 26 percentage point margin for those expecting to increase spending.
The biggest difference in favour of those expecting to increase advertising was in direct advertising -- 40 percentage points.
The most optimistic cyclical view was in the trade sector, the association said.
"Eighty-one percent assume demand to grow in 1997 compared to this year," it said.
In industry, the figure was 47 percent and in services 53 percent, it said. -- Helsinki newsroom +358-0-6805 0245
